intro_fa: با he، she و نام کار، به فعل s می‌چسبد: A baker makes bread. کلمهٔ زیاد همان فعل بدون s است. جمله را بساز.
say_en: A baker makes bread.
done_en: A baker makes bread.

say_en: A driver drives a lorry.
done_en: A driver drives a lorry.

say_en: A weaver makes carpets.
done_en: A weaver makes carpets.

say_en: A farmer grows wheat.
done_en: A farmer grows wheat.

say_en: A builder builds houses.
done_en: A builder builds houses.

say_en: He repairs cars and lorries.
done_en: He repairs cars and lorries.
help_fa: او موترها و لاری‌ها را ترمیم می‌کند.

say_en: She is an engineer.
done_en: She is an engineer.

say_en: What does a mechanic do?
done_en: What does a mechanic do?

say_en: My mother is a weaver.
done_en: My mother is a weaver.

intro_fa: بگو که هر کس کجا و با چه کار می‌کند: in برای جای، with برای افزار. جمله را بساز.
say_en: Where does she work?
done_en: Where does she work?

say_en: She works in a clinic.
done_en: She works in a clinic.

say_en: The farmer works in the field.
done_en: The farmer works in the field.

say_en: He works with a saw.
done_en: He works with a saw.

say_en: He drives a tractor.
done_en: He drives a tractor.

say_en: The builder works with bricks.
done_en: The builder works with bricks.

say_en: My brother works in a workshop.
done_en: My brother works in a workshop.

say_en: Where does your father work?
done_en: Where does your father work?

say_en: The teacher works in a school.
done_en: The teacher works in a school.

intro_fa: I want to be یعنی «می‌خواهم ... شوم». بعد از want کلمهٔ to می‌آید. برای کس دیگر: She wants to be. جمله را بساز.
say_en: I want to be a teacher.
done_en: I want to be a teacher.

say_en: What do you want to be?
done_en: What do you want to be?

say_en: She wants to be a doctor.
done_en: She wants to be a doctor.

say_en: He wants to be a driver.
done_en: He wants to be a driver.

say_en: I want to be an engineer.
done_en: I want to be an engineer.

say_en: I must learn a lot.
done_en: I must learn a lot.

say_en: I like to help people.
done_en: I like to help people.
help_fa: من کمک کردن به مردم را خوش دارم.

say_en: We want to be farmers.
done_en: We want to be farmers.

say_en: Does he want to be a baker?
done_en: Does he want to be a baker?

intro_fa: برای پلان: I am going to، He is going to، We are going to، و بعد فعل ساده. کلمهٔ زیاد am، is یا are غلط است. جمله را بساز.
say_en: I am going to visit my aunt.
done_en: I am going to visit my aunt.

say_en: He is going to buy shoes.
done_en: He is going to buy shoes.

say_en: We are going to play.
done_en: We are going to play.

say_en: It is going to rain.
done_en: It is going to rain.

say_en: She is going to cook rice.
done_en: She is going to cook rice.

say_en: They are going to walk.
done_en: They are going to walk.

say_en: I am going to read tonight.
done_en: I am going to read tonight.

say_en: My uncle is going to come tomorrow.
done_en: My uncle is going to come tomorrow.

say_en: We are going to help mother.
done_en: We are going to help mother.

intro_fa: در سوال am، is یا are اول می‌آید: Are you going to come? برای «نه» not پیش از going می‌آید. جمله را بساز.
say_en: Are you going to come?
done_en: Are you going to come?

say_en: Yes, I am.
done_en: Yes, I am.

say_en: No, I'm not.
done_en: No, I'm not.

say_en: What are you going to do?
done_en: What are you going to do?

say_en: She is not going to cook.
done_en: She is not going to cook.

say_en: Is he going to walk?
done_en: Is he going to walk?

say_en: I am not going to sleep.
done_en: I am not going to sleep.

say_en: Are they going to play?
done_en: Are they going to play?

say_en: When are you going to come?
done_en: When are you going to come?

intro_fa: برای مقایسه: صفت با er و بعد than. A horse is bigger than a goat. کلمهٔ زیاد صفت بدون er است. جمله را بساز.
say_en: A horse is bigger than a goat.
done_en: A horse is bigger than a goat.

say_en: My brother is taller than me.
done_en: My brother is taller than me.

say_en: The rabbit is faster than the tortoise.
done_en: The rabbit is faster than the tortoise.

say_en: She is younger than me.
done_en: She is younger than me.

say_en: The city is bigger than the village.
done_en: The city is bigger than the village.

say_en: A mouse is smaller than a cat.
done_en: A mouse is smaller than a cat.

say_en: I am stronger than you.
done_en: I am stronger than you.

say_en: Winter is colder than autumn.
done_en: Winter is colder than autumn.

say_en: Who is taller?
done_en: Who is taller?

intro_fa: با صفت دراز more می‌آید و بعد than. و یاد داشته باش: better بهتر، worse بدتر. جمله را بساز.
say_en: The carpet is more expensive than the scarf.
done_en: The carpet is more expensive than the scarf.

say_en: This dress is more beautiful.
done_en: This dress is more beautiful.

say_en: My new shoes are better.
done_en: My new shoes are better.

say_en: The weather is worse today.
done_en: The weather is worse today.

say_en: The bus is faster than the bicycle.
done_en: The bus is faster than the bicycle.

say_en: The bicycle is cheaper.
done_en: The bicycle is cheaper.

say_en: English is more difficult than Dari.
done_en: English is more difficult than Dari.

say_en: This book is better than that book.
done_en: This book is better than that book.
help_fa: این کتاب از آن کتاب بهتر است.

say_en: Which is better?
done_en: Which is better?

intro_fa: سوال با Why شروع می‌شود و جواب با Because. با because دو جمله یکجا می‌شود. جمله را بساز.
say_en: Why are you happy?
done_en: Why are you happy?

say_en: Because it is Friday.
done_en: Because it is Friday.

say_en: I am afraid because it is dark.
done_en: I am afraid because it is dark.

say_en: Why are you late?
done_en: Why are you late?

say_en: Because the bus was slow.
done_en: Because the bus was slow.

say_en: She is sad because she is alone.
done_en: She is sad because she is alone.
help_fa: او غمگین است چون تنها است.

say_en: Why is mother worried?
done_en: Why is mother worried?

say_en: He is angry because his kite is lost.
done_en: He is angry because his kite is lost.
help_fa: او قهر است چون کاغذپرانش گم شده است.

say_en: I am calm because you are here.
done_en: I am calm because you are here.
help_fa: من آرام هستم چون تو اینجا هستی.

intro_fa: جمله‌های دراز با because: اول کار یا آرزو، بعد دلیل. حصه‌های جمله روی کارت‌ها است. آنها را به ترتیب بگذار.
say_en: I want to be a doctor because I like to help.
tiles: t:I want|t:to be|t:a doctor|t:because|t:I like|t:to help
done_en: I want to be a doctor because I like to help.
help_fa: من می‌خواهم داکتر شوم چون کمک کردن را خوش دارم.

say_en: I take an umbrella because it is raining.
done_en: I take an umbrella because it is raining.
help_fa: من چتری می‌گیرم چون باران می‌بارد.

say_en: We go by bus because it is far.
done_en: We go by bus because it is far.
help_fa: ما با بس می‌رویم چون دور است.

say_en: I like spring because it is warm.
done_en: I like spring because it is warm.
help_fa: من بهار را خوش دارم چون هوا گرم است.

say_en: I am tired because I worked.
done_en: I am tired because I worked.
help_fa: من مانده هستم چون کار کردم.

say_en: He wants to be a farmer because he likes animals.
done_en: He wants to be a farmer because he likes animals.
help_fa: او می‌خواهد دهقان شود چون حیوان‌ها را خوش دارد.

say_en: She learns English because she wants to read.
done_en: She learns English because she wants to read.
help_fa: او انگلیسی یاد می‌گیرد چون می‌خواهد بخواند.

say_en: I am going to sleep because I am tired.
done_en: I am going to sleep because I am tired.

say_en: We stay at home because it is raining.
done_en: We stay at home because it is raining.
help_fa: ما در خانه می‌مانیم چون باران می‌بارد.

intro_fa: دو قسم کار است. در جمله‌ها کلمه‌ها را به ترتیب بگذار. در قصه‌های کوتاه تصویرها را به ترتیب قصه بگذار: One day، Then، Suddenly، Finally.
say_en: One day a fox saw a crow.
done_en: One day a fox saw a crow.
help_fa: یک روز یک روباه یک زاغ را دید.

say_en: Suddenly it started to rain.
done_en: Suddenly it started to rain.

say_en: Finally they came home.
done_en: Finally they came home.

say_en: In the end everybody was happy.
done_en: In the end everybody was happy.

say_en: Then I saw a fish.
done_en: Then I saw a fish.

say_en: One day a girl walked to the river. Then she saw a fish. Suddenly it started to rain. Finally she ran home.
done_en: One day a girl walked to the river. Then she saw a fish. Suddenly it started to rain. Finally she ran home.
help_fa: یک روز دختری پیاده به دریا رفت. بعد یک ماهی دید. ناگهان باران شروع شد. بالاخره به خانه دوید. تصویرها را به همین ترتیب بگذار.

say_en: One day a boy took the sheep to the hill. Suddenly a wolf came. The boy shouted. Finally the wolf ran away and the boy was happy.
done_en: One day a boy took the sheep to the hill. Suddenly a wolf came. The boy shouted. Finally the wolf ran away and the boy was happy.
help_fa: یک روز پسری گوسفندها را به تپه برد. ناگهان یک گرگ آمد. پسر چیغ زد. بالاخره گرگ گریخت و پسر خوش شد.

say_en: One day a crow was thirsty. Then it saw a jug. It dropped stones into the jug. Finally it drank.
done_en: One day a crow was thirsty. Then it saw a jug. It dropped stones into the jug. Finally it drank.
help_fa: یک روز یک زاغ تشنه بود. بعد یک کوزه دید. در کوزه سنگ انداخت. بالاخره آب نوشید.

say_en: One day it snowed. Then the children made a snowman. Suddenly the sun came. In the end there was only water.
done_en: One day it snowed. Then the children made a snowman. Suddenly the sun came. In the end there was only water.
help_fa: یک روز برف بارید. بعد اطفال آدم برفی ساختند. ناگهان آفتاب برآمد. در آخر فقط آب ماند.

intro_fa: بگو که کی چه گفت. said گفت، asked پرسید، answered جواب داد. بعد از سوال asked می‌آید، نه said. جمله را بساز.
say_en: The fox said hello.
done_en: The fox said hello.

say_en: The crow asked a question.
done_en: The crow asked a question.

say_en: The teacher answered the question.
done_en: The teacher answered the question.

say_en: The children laughed.
done_en: The children laughed.

say_en: The boy shouted for help.
done_en: The boy shouted for help.

say_en: What did the teacher say?
done_en: What did the teacher say?

say_en: She said thank you.
done_en: She said thank you.

say_en: He asked the way to the clinic.
done_en: He asked the way to the clinic.

say_en: I asked my mother.
done_en: I asked my mother.

intro_fa: حالا خودت یک پیام می‌نویسی، با کارت‌ها. پیام سه حصه دارد: اول Dear و نام، بعد گپ اصلی، در آخر From و نام. کارت‌ها را به ترتیب بگذار.
say_en: Dear Sara, How are you? I am fine. From Mina.
tiles: t:Dear Sara,|t:How are you?|t:I am fine.|t:From Mina
done_en: Dear Sara, How are you? I am fine. From Mina.
help_fa: سارای عزیز، چطور هستی؟ من خوب هستم. از طرف مینا.

say_en: Dear Omar, I am going to come on Friday. From Ali.
tiles: t:Dear Omar,|t:I am going|t:to come|t:on Friday.|t:From Ali
done_en: Dear Omar, I am going to come on Friday. From Ali.
help_fa: عمر عزیز، من روز جمعه می‌آیم. از طرف علی.

say_en: Dear mother, I am in Kabul. I am fine. From Farid.
tiles: t:Dear mother,|t:I am in Kabul.|t:I am fine.|t:From Farid
done_en: Dear mother, I am in Kabul. I am fine. From Farid.
help_fa: مادر عزیز، من در کابل هستم. من خوب هستم. از طرف فرید.

say_en: Dear Laila, Thank you for the letter. From Roya.
tiles: t:Dear Laila,|t:Thank you|t:for the letter.|t:From Roya
done_en: Dear Laila, Thank you for the letter. From Roya.
help_fa: لیلای عزیز، تشکر از خط تو. از طرف رویا.

say_en: How are you?
done_en: How are you?

say_en: See you soon.
done_en: See you soon.

say_en: I am going to write a letter.
done_en: I am going to write a letter.

say_en: The letter is from my uncle.
done_en: The letter is from my uncle.
help_fa: این خط از طرف کاکایم است.

say_en: Dear uncle, I am going to visit you next week. From Yusuf.
tiles: t:Dear uncle,|t:I am going|t:to visit you|t:next week.|t:From Yusuf
done_en: Dear uncle, I am going to visit you next week. From Yusuf.
help_fa: کاکای عزیز، هفتهٔ آینده به دیدن شما می‌آیم. از طرف یوسف.

intro_fa: سه قسم پیام را با کارت‌ها بنویس: دعوت، تشکر و معذرت. اول Dear، در آخر From. در معذرت دلیل را با because بگو.
say_en: Dear Shirin, Please come to my house on Friday. From Nargis.
tiles: t:Dear Shirin,|t:Please come|t:to my house|t:on Friday.|t:From Nargis
done_en: Dear Shirin, Please come to my house on Friday. From Nargis.
help_fa: شیرین عزیز، لطفاً روز جمعه به خانهٔ ما بیا. از طرف نرگس.

say_en: Dear aunt, Thank you for the present. From Navid.
done_en: Dear aunt, Thank you for the present. From Navid.
help_fa: خالهٔ عزیز، تشکر از تحفه. از طرف نوید.

say_en: Dear Karim, I am sorry. I am sick. From Hamid.
tiles: t:Dear Karim,|t:I am sorry.|t:I am sick.|t:From Hamid
done_en: Dear Karim, I am sorry. I am sick. From Hamid.
help_fa: کریم عزیز، ببخش. من مریض هستم. از طرف حمید.

say_en: Dear Hamid, Get well soon! See you soon. From Karim.
tiles: t:Dear Hamid,|t:Get well soon!|t:See you soon.|t:From Karim
done_en: Dear Hamid, Get well soon! See you soon. From Karim.
help_fa: حمید عزیز، زود جور شوی! به امید دیدار. از طرف کریم.

say_en: Thank you for the present.
done_en: Thank you for the present.

say_en: I am sorry I am late.
done_en: I am sorry I am late.

say_en: Please come to my house.
done_en: Please come to my house.

say_en: I can't come because I am sick.
done_en: I can't come because I am sick.

say_en: Dear teacher, I am sorry. I was late. From Zarmina.
tiles: t:Dear teacher,|t:I am sorry.|t:I was late.|t:From Zarmina
done_en: Dear teacher, I am sorry. I was late. From Zarmina.
help_fa: معلم عزیز، ببخشید. من ناوقت آمدم. از طرف زرمینه.

intro_fa: جمله‌هایی از آینده: going to و because با هم. جمله را بساز.

done_en: I am going to study.

say_en: I am going to help my village.
done_en: I am going to help my village.
help_fa: من به قریهٔ خود کمک می‌کنم.

say_en: We are going to build a new school.
done_en: We are going to build a new school.

say_en: I want to be an engineer.
done_en: I want to be an engineer.

say_en: Our village needs a doctor.
done_en: Our village needs a doctor.
help_fa: قریهٔ ما به داکتر ضرورت دارد.

say_en: I learn English because I want to read.
done_en: I learn English because I want to read.
help_fa: من انگلیسی یاد می‌گیرم چون می‌خواهم بخوانم.

say_en: She is going to be a teacher.
done_en: She is going to be a teacher.

say_en: Why do you want to study?
done_en: Why do you want to study?

say_en: I am not afraid.
done_en: I am not afraid.
